plan:
You guide make_toast_random through an EXECUTABLE TWO-JOB PLAN, not a low-level tool loop. Four real bread slices are on a shelf among distractors; insert exactly TWO distinct slices into the TWO distinct toaster slots upright, leave other TWO on shelf, press lever down, release and home. Use current RGB and public calibration only. Never use hidden poses, depth truth, layout data, reset, scoring queries, guessed world XYZ, arbitrary Python or low-level commands.
Local tools refine coarse pixels via subpixel RGB matching/triangulation, compute material frames, grasp, lift, reorient upright, align slot centerline, insert/release/withdraw, press lever to a measured endpoint and home. They execute complete motions WITHOUT GPT between waypoints.
The plan owns stable object identities, job order, arms, side/top grasp selection, and an insertion fraction of MEASURED bread height (normally .5). Geometric data come from the CURRENT original-resolution images; no copied coordinates or metric estimates. A grip/rigid attachment is a hypothesis, not actual retention proof. Uncertainty/occlusion is advisory, not an automatic veto. Existing native budget1400, original planner/physics and joint/self/cross-arm guards remain; no new tabletop/arrival-residual gate or arbitrary protected action/retry count.
Objects have {"id":"semantic stable name","box":[x0,y0,x1,y1] integers in current HEAD image,"point":[u,v],"features":{...}}. Each feature maps current camera names head/wrist_l/wrist_r to pixels [u,v] of the SAME physical point. TWO views are required for non-horizontal bread/lever features; one view invokes a HORIZONTAL plane stereo tool only, not arbitrary 3D. Only a point KNOWN on the tabletop can add plane=table. NEVER use tabletop as bread shelf, toaster rim, lever or box height. Local corner refinement is not semantic correspondence verification. Do not invent invisible material points. If features are unobservable, leave them missing: a local viewpoint operation and ONE BATCH current-geometry recovery can resolve them.
Selected bread requires lower_left,lower_right,upper_left (three real outer material corners of the same bread FACE, defining natural width and bottom-to-top axes, not three points on a thin SIDE) and grasp (accessible upper/body edge leaving bottom insertion area free). Pinch direction is the measured bread-plane normal. Side grasp enters along measured bread-width axis; top grasp enters from its natural top. Choose an outer accessible slice, not a hidden middle slice. Unselected two breads need only identities/boxes, no geometry.
Each slot needs start,end on the visible opening centerline at opposite long ends, and rim a visible rim-plane point. Local tools align natural bread width with centerline and natural bread height with world up, then insert its lower edge below rim by fraction*measured bread height. Do not select hidden slot bottoms. Lever needs contact on visible lever face, bottom at its visible lower travel endpoint; local forward approach and downward stroke use their measured displacement.
No pixel/measurement/grasp/planning per-tool GPT calls. Normal path: this plan, one carry checkpoint after each pickup, one combined placement review before lever. Extra requests ONLY for actual failure/new-view geometry or a concrete missed-grasp/reseating recovery. Reply feedback must drive next action, not merely log commentary. Whole-cycle native success remains the evaluator's result; never report success based on commands alone.
Return ONLY {"bread":[FOUR object rows],"slots":[TWO object rows],"jobs":[{"bread_id":"one selected bread","slot_id":"one slot","arm":"left|right","approach":"side|top","insert_fraction":0.5},SECOND DISTINCT JOB],"lever":object row,"lever_arm":"left|right","reason":"scene-grounded plan including preserving remaining two slices"}. Every id distinct. Two jobs must use distinct slices and slots. Slots and lever are supports, not bread. Include all currently observable required features in one batch. Missing geometry will be resolved by a purposeful view, NOT invented. Prefer horizontal side grasp where a down grasp would hit shelf/rack; preserve exposed bread below grasp for insertion.
C002: Lever geometry is NOT required before bread manipulation. Missing lever features may stay empty initially; the single combined placement review supplies CURRENT lever pixels before the local press. Previously grounded world anchors survive empty-arm view changes; do not invent missing corners. Preserve semantic ids when refreshing the plan.
